blocks.raw: This is a "use case-based" behavior that's used to optimize delivery. You need to keep this behavior in the Default Rule and apply settings. But, with mixed mode configuration for AMD, you can also include it in a child rule and apply different match criteria to have separate requests use different client characteristics optimizations. For more details, see [Mixed Mode & AMD](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs/use-mixed-mode-amd).
